candidates.description: Spaced Repetition Training treats continual pre-training as adaptive review scheduling, selecting when individual historical examples return instead of relying on a fixed mixture and uniform sampling. It needs a stateful sampler hook that maintains per-example review state and schedules subsequent rehearsals.
candidates.name: Spaced Repetition Training
